features.description: Add `setLightPalette(name)` and `setDarkPalette(name)` exports to `src/js/shared/theme.js`. Each function sets the corresponding `data-*-palette` attribute on `documentElement` and persists to localStorage. Add unit tests for both functions covering valid palettes, invalid palettes (graceful handling), and DOM attribute updates.
preconditions: Existing theme.js exports initTheme, toggleTheme, updateThemeIndicator, validatePalette
expectedBehavior: setLightPalette('nord') sets data-light-palette='nord' on documentElement and localStorage.lightPalette='nord'
setDarkPalette('monokai') sets data-dark-palette='monokai' on documentElement and localStorage.darkPalette='monokai'
Both functions handle invalid palette names gracefully (no crash)
New unit tests pass alongside all existing 26 tests
npm run lint passes
verificationSteps: npm run test -- all tests pass including new palette setter tests

features.description: Extract all inline JavaScript from start.html into src/js/start-app.js as a proper ES module. Replace 3 inline `<script>` blocks at end of body with one `<script type="module" src="/src/js/start-app.js">`. Import shared modules: initTheme/toggleTheme/setLightPalette/setDarkPalette from shared/theme.js, initPageTransitions from shared/pageTransitions.js, saveUserProfile/getUserProfile from shared/profile.js, showToast from shared/ui-utils.js. Keep all page-specific logic (form validation, profile lifecycle, export/import, Tauri download folder integration) in start-app.js. Retain the inline `<head>` flash-prevention script. Zero behavior change.
preconditions: setLightPalette/setDarkPalette available in shared/theme.js (from prior feature)
start.html has 3 inline <script> blocks totaling ~500 lines of JS
vite.config.js already lists start.html as a multi-page entry point
expectedBehavior: start.html body ends with single <script type="module" src="/src/js/start-app.js"></script>
start-app.js imports and uses initTheme, toggleTheme, setLightPalette, setDarkPalette from shared/theme.js
start-app.js imports and uses initPageTransitions from shared/pageTransitions.js
start-app.js imports and uses saveUserProfile/getUserProfile from shared/profile.js
start-app.js imports and uses showToast from shared/ui-utils.js (replaces inline toast)
Inline <head> flash-prevention script remains unchanged
All form validation functions preserved identically
Profile save/load cycle works identically
Export/import JSON round-trip works identically
Tauri download folder integration preserved
Theme toggle and palette selectors work identically
Page transitions work identically (now using shared module with bfcache support)
npm run dev serves start.html without errors
npm run lint passes
All existing tests pass
verificationSteps: npm run test -- all tests pass
npm run dev, navigate to http://localhost:8080/start.html, verify page loads without console errors
Manual: fill profile form, save, reload -- data persists
Manual: toggle theme, change palette, reload -- persists
Manual: export profile, verify JSON download
Manual: import profile, verify form populated
